# Sneaky Clean

> Locally owned mobile auto detailing company based in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. We come to homes, offices, apartments, and approved locations in Murfreesboro, Smyrna, La Vergne, Nashville, Franklin, Brentwood, and surrounding Middle Tennessee.

Key facts:
- Refresh Detail from $199 (maintained vehicles, about 2-2.5 hours)
- Full Reset Detail from $299 (daily drivers and family vehicles, about 4-5 hours)
- Interior Detail has variable pricing based on interior condition and the work required. Send photos for a custom quote: https://www.sneakycleantn.com/interior-detailing-murfreesboro/
- Paint correction, ceramic coating, and motorcycle detailing quoted after review
- Monthly car-care memberships: Undercover Agent: $99/month for 1 vehicle or $179/month for 2. Once a month: exterior wash, interior vacuum, interior wipe-down, and windows; 15% off additional full details and upgrades. Special Agent: $149/month for 1 vehicle or $269/month for 2. Monthly Undercover cleaning: exterior wash, interior vacuum, interior wipe-down, and windows; One quarterly Refresh Detail, interior and exterior; 20% off additional full details and upgrades. Black Ops: $199/month for 1 vehicle or $359/month for 2. Your choice: Undercover cleaning every two weeks or one monthly deep clean; Includes the Special Agent quarterly Refresh Detail, interior and exterior; 30% off additional full details and upgrades. Each vehicle requires a separate $199 initial deep clean ($398 for two). Book each initial clean online; recurring billing is set up separately in Square after the initial clean.
- Initial deep clean: separate $199 per vehicle ($398 for two), before monthly membership care.
- Start a membership by booking each vehicle’s initial clean: https://www.sneakycleantn.com/#membership
- Online booking with live appointment times runs Monday, Wednesday, and Friday: https://www.sneakycleantn.com/
- Tuesday and Thursday are reserved for rush jobs. Request a slot by text: (717) 870-9439
- 5.0 Google rating
